scope: Sanitized aggregate disposition index for the uploaded AI-team research.
privacy_note: The public repository file intentionally excludes raw contacts, public business emails, protected profiles, licensed rows, and contact-level evidence. The private reconciliation workbook is the review artifact.

disposition_definitions.accept_verified_source: Eligible for the source catalog, subject to field-level terms, rate, retention, attribution, and freshness controls.
disposition_definitions.accept_verified_route: Current first-party route supported by official evidence. Execution still requires human approval.
disposition_definitions.verify_official_source: Discovery seed only until current first-party identity and terms are recorded.
disposition_definitions.verify_official_route: Potential route that remains non-actionable until current first-party policy and eligibility are verified.
disposition_definitions.existing_record_review: Probable or exact live ArtistOS match. Enrich and reverify; do not create a duplicate.
disposition_definitions.external_handoff: Account-based marketplace or protected platform. Deep-link and store user-owned receipts/outcomes only.
disposition_definitions.partnership_required: Blocked until provider approval and commercial terms are obtained.
disposition_definitions.license_review: Blocked until written ingestion, storage, display, refresh, correction, and export rights are approved.
disposition_definitions.quarantine_identity: Blocked by masked contact, malformed stable ID, ambiguous ownership, or unresolved duplicate.
disposition_definitions.quarantine_policy: Blocked by unofficial interface, stale or conflicting policy, or unsupported acquisition method.
disposition_definitions.reject_ineligible: ArtistOS or the current artist/release is not eligible for the route or API.
disposition_definitions.reject_no_unsolicited: The source or property explicitly disallows the proposed submission or outreach route.
